scripts.build: node scripts/ws.mjs build tokens icons ui ui-react app-bridge review
scripts.test: node scripts/check-scale.mjs && node scripts/ws.mjs test ui ui-react app-bridge review
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/ws.mjs build tokens icons && tsc -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui-react/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/app-bridge/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/review/tsconfig.json
